status: LOCKED_SHARED_UPSTREAM_CONTRACT (extracted from the final SOG head: Phase 1A B2 retained; attempts extension frozen, therefore NOT part of the state)
purpose: the single reusable pregame state for SOG, goals, assists, points and the skater-dependent parts of goalie / team heads. Heads consume this state; they may add head-specific inputs ONLY through their own preregistered protocol.

information_cutoff.definition: information_cutoff = scheduled_start - horizon (T24H / T90 / T30 / T10 / T2 forward; the historical reference is the deterministic T90)
information_cutoff.completed_before_rule: a source game is usable iff source_start + 210 min <= information_cutoff and source_game_id != target_game_id
information_cutoff.same_day: a same-day earlier game is excluded unless certainly over

target_team_membership_evidence.historical: candidate universe = skaters who appeared FOR THE TARGET TEAM in its last <=10 prior completed games (Phase 0B)
target_team_membership_evidence.forward: pregame rosterSpots snapshot (collector, status UNVALIDATED) with its capture timestamp and horizon validity
target_team_membership_evidence.unobservable: a target participant absent from the evidence is UNOBSERVABLE and never inserted from target truth

inputs_available_before_the_cutoff.participation_evidence: prior-team-game appearance history (PLAY_RATE_*, games / days since appearance); forward right-rail scratches / rosterSpots when a valid horizon snapshot exists (UNVALIDATED); never injury knowledge that was not available at the cutoff
inputs_available_before_the_cutoff.expected_historical_TOI_state: recent current-team TOI means / deltas (Phase 1A); a predictive TOI DISTRIBUTION is NOT part of the contract yet (RESEARCH)
inputs_available_before_the_cutoff.EV_PP_role_state: current-team PP / EV allocation shares and shift counts (allocation, not true opportunity)
inputs_available_before_the_cutoff.all_team_skill_history: legal prior completed games of ANY team, only after membership is established
inputs_available_before_the_cutoff.team_shot_environment: own team official SOG mean over last <=5 completed team games
inputs_available_before_the_cutoff.opponent_shot_environment: opponent SOG allowed mean over its last <=5 completed games
inputs_available_before_the_cutoff.home_away_schedule: IS_HOME, team rest hours, back-to-back from the schedule
evidence_coverage_and_missingness: explicit missing indicator for every continuous feature (training-only median imputation)

AVAILABILITY_PARTICIPATION.must_use: current-team appearances and that team's prior completed games

leakage_rules: R1 postgame target-game information can NEVER enter state: no target dressed list, rosterSpots-as-truth, scratches, boxscore, TOI, EV/PP/SH split, shifts, position, SOG, goals, assists, events, starter flag
R2 every source game must satisfy source_start + 210 min <= information_cutoff and != target game
R3 current-role features use current-team appearances only; skill features may use all-team history only after membership is established
R4 the target game's labels are read only after the team-game's features are complete (labels are grading-only)
R5 mutating any target-game row must leave every state feature bit-identical (tested)
R6 no sportsbook line / odds / projection / ranking is ever a state input
R7 forward snapshots count only when captured inside the registered valid window of their horizon (early / late / post-puck-drop captures are not state)
R8 an INVALID / uncertified source row is missing, never imputed from another source

TEAM_REST_HOURS.window: previous team game start -> target start
TEAM_REST_HOURS.note: raw kept, capped 240 for regression input only

PP_ALLOC_SHARE_MEAN_CT_APP3.note: allocation share, not true PP opportunity

consumers.skater_shots_on_goal: all blocks (Phase 1A B2 = the reference consumer)
consumers.skater_goals: SKILL + CURRENT_ROLE_DEPLOYMENT + TEAM/OPPONENT environment + AVAILABILITY; adds a goals-specific skill / conversion history through its OWN preregistered protocol
consumers.skater_assists: CURRENT_ROLE_DEPLOYMENT + TEAM environment + AVAILABILITY; assist-involvement history added only by its own protocol
consumers.skater_points: derived from the joint goals / assists process (identity-checked), not an independent classifier
consumers.goalie_and_team_heads: TEAM_SHOT_ENVIRONMENT, OPPONENT_SHOT_ENVIRONMENT, SCHEDULE_VENUE and the aggregated skater state (expected lineup strength) where scientifically valid; goalie start state is NOT part of this contract (BLOCKED / separate)

versioning: a change to any block definition requires a new contract version and a new preregistered head protocol; heads record the contract version + data snapshot hash they consumed
